findings.text: the bounding-surface stroke is now a hardcoded hex literal, replacing the named ink role DEFAULT_INK.separatrix_color, in both the draw call and the legend handle at line 281; nova's plotting rules require a figure colour to be a named role in the style module so a reader recognises the component across figures, and the literal now silently diverges from that owner. The correct repair is a named role in nova/media/ink.py, outside this node's fence.
